verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents a public API in depth. It covers personal `pk_` tokens and OAuth2 auth, create/update/move operations on tasks, attachments, custom task types, task filtering, views, and comments. It also offers an interactive "Try It" panel, per-version OpenAPI specs and a live llms.txt. The probe's 404s on common OpenAPI paths only mean the spec isn't at a guessed well-known URL; the docs say it is published per version, so this is a minor discoverability gap, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the API works as documented, and a spec at a standard discoverable path.
